description: 指定福祉避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宜野座村. 災害時の指定福祉避難所です。. Coverage: 宜野座村. The portal files it under the publisher 宜野座村. Its tags are 災害, 災害_避難所_防災, 福祉避難所. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-02-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
